info.name: Clerk Backend Account Portal Organizations API
Get a List of Organizations for an Instance

params.name: include_members_count
params.description: Flag to denote whether the member counts of each organization should be included in the response or not.

params.name: include_missing_member_with_elevated_permissions
params.description: Flag to denote whether or not to include a member with elevated permissions who is not currently a member of the organization.

params.name: query
params.description:
Returns organizations with ID, name, or slug that match the given query.
Uses exact match for organization ID and partial match for name and slug.

params.name: user_id
params.description:
Returns organizations that include any of the specified user IDs as members. Any user IDs not found are ignored.
For each user ID, the `+` and `-` can be prepended to the ID, which denote whether the
respective organization should be included or excluded from the result set.

params.name: organization_id
params.description:
Returns organizations with the organization IDs specified. Any organization IDs not found are ignored.
For each organization ID, the `+` and `-` can be prepended to the ID, which denote whether the
respective organization should be included or excluded from the result set. Accepts up to 100 organization IDs.
Example: ?organization_id=+org_1&organization_id=-org_2

params.name: order_by
params.description:
Allows to return organizations in a particular order.
At the moment, you can order the returned organizations either by their `name`, `created_at` or `members_count`.
In order to specify the direction, you can use the `+/-` symbols prepended in the property to order by.
For example, if you want organizations to be returned in descending order according to their `created_at` property, you can use `-created_at`.
If you don't use `+` or `-`, then `+` is implied.
Defaults to `-created_at`.

params.name: limit
params.description:
Applies a limit to the number of results returned.
Can be used for paginating the results together with `offset`.

params.name: offset
params.description:
Skip the first `offset` results when paginating.
Needs to be an integer greater or equal to zero.
To be used in conjunction with `limit`.

items.docs:
This request returns the list of organizations for an instance.
Results can be paginated using the optional `limit` and `offset` query parameters.
The organizations are ordered by descending creation date.
Most recent organizations will be returned first.

Creates a new organization with the given name for an instance.
You can specify an optional slug for the new organization.
If provided, the organization slug can contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters (letters and digits) and the dash "-".
Organization slugs must be unique for the instance.
You can provide additional metadata for the organization and set any custom attribute you want.
Organizations support private and public metadata.
Private metadata can only be accessed from the Backen

info.name: Retrieve an Organization by ID or Slug

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID or slug of the organization

params.name: include_members_count
params.description: Flag to denote whether or not the organization's members count should be included in the response.

params.name: include_missing_member_with_elevated_permissions
params.description: Flag to denote whether or not to include a member with elevated permissions who is not currently a member of the organization.

items.docs: Fetches the organization whose ID or slug matches the provided `id_or_slug` URL query parameter.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization to update

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization to delete

items.docs:
Deletes the given organization.
Please note that deleting an organization will also delete all memberships and invitations.
This is not reversible.

After the organization is deleted, any user's active sessions that contain the deleted
organization will be cleared.

info.name: Merge and Update Metadata for an Organization

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization for which metadata will be merged or updated

items.docs:
Update organization metadata attributes by merging existing values with the provided parameters.
Metadata values will be updated via a deep merge.
Deep meaning that any nested JSON objects will be merged as well.
You can remove metadata keys at any level by setting their value to `null`.

info.name: Upload a Logo for the Organization

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization for which to upload a logo

items.docs:
Set or replace an organization's logo, by uploading an image file.
This endpoint uses the `multipart/form-data` request content type and accepts a file of image type.
The file size cannot exceed 10MB.
Only the following file content types are supported: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization for which the logo will be deleted.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization whose subscription to retrieve

items.docs:
Retrieves the billing subscription for the specified organization.
This includes subscription details, active plans, billing information, and payment status.
The subscription contains subscription items which represent the individual plans the organization is subscribed to.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization whose credit balance to retrieve

items.docs:
Retrieves the current credit balance for the specified organization.
Credits can be applied during checkout to reduce the charge or automatically applied to upcoming recurring charges.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization whose credit balance to adjust

items.docs:
Increases or decreases the credit balance for the specified organization.
Each adjustment is recorded as a ledger entry. The idempotency_key parameter
ensures that duplicate requests are safely handled.
